problem:
A study shows that for a particular area in a specific season,

- on a day that follows a day without precipitation, there is a $25%$ chance to have rain and a $35%$ chance to have snow.

- on a day that follows a rainy day, there is a $40%$ chance not to have precipitation and a $5%$ chance to have snow.

- on a day that follows a snowy day, there is a $50%$ chance not to have precipitation and a $5%$ chance to have rain.

The stochastic matrix that describes this situation is given below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
P=[\begin{aligned}a & 0.4 & 0.5 \\ 0.25 & b & 0.05 \\ 0.35 & 0.05 & c\end{aligned}]
$$
